objective: Activate persistent, audit-ready per-profile decision rationale after Part 2 validation while preserving human/main-host authority and privacy.

constraints.text: Current explicit user continuation authorizes Part 3; saved plan remains subordinate to current instruction.
No private chain-of-thought, hidden scratchpad or reconstructed internal reasoning may be requested or stored.
constraints.provenance: existing Reasoning Auditor boundary + Part 3 acceptance criteria

constraints.text: Reasoning Auditor findings remain advisory and cannot auto-integrate changes.

claims.text: The runtime now has an active cross-profile decision-record mechanism with append-only storage and explicit emission/skip rules.
The mechanism is schema-validated and covered by deterministic regression tests.

alternatives.option: Persist raw/private reasoning transcripts per agent.
alternatives.reason: Violates privacy boundary and is unnecessary for an auditable causal record.

alternatives.option: Keep decision records deferred after Part 2.
alternatives.reason: Part 2 completed the explicit validation gate and the user authorized continuation.

alternatives.option: Use concise append-only structured decision records with evidence links.
alternatives.reason: Meets auditability goals while preserving privacy, provenance and main-host governance.

decision: Activate core.auditable_decision_records and decision_record_policy; persist only material externalizable decision summaries under per-profile append-only paths, and let Reasoning Auditor consume them as evidence/data without mutation authority.

unknowns.text: Production usefulness, record volume and false-positive audit impact are not yet measured; future real-session evidence should inform Part 5 cadence/sampling.

verification.check: Semantic convergence: stable fixed point in 2 passes
